accentRule: The script distinguishes Norse vs Egyptian by LANGUAGE + subtitles (e.g. Ipy/Seth-Nakht/Meryt speak Egyptian, subtitled), NOT by accent. The FR dub therefore differentiates characters by REGISTER, texture, cadence and emotional arc — NOT by stereotyped cultural/ethnic accents, for which the script gives no justification. Optional, non-caricatured distinction: Egyptian civic characters may carry a slightly more formal/measured FR register (a settled civilisation) and Norse crew a plainer weather-worn register (seafarers) — a register choice, never a mock accent.
globalContinuity: One fixed voiceprint per character across ALL scenes (same casting/sample); no drift in age or texture.
Emotional arcs are directed, not re-cast: the same voice evolves (e.g. Astrid doubt→resolve).
Breath/age texture consistent (Olaf's failing breath, Nefer-ka's elder dryness).
Subtitled in-world languages keep their original-language delivery on the reference track; FR dub matches timing + emotion, lip-syncable.
No visual/vocal quality is validated until a human inspects REAL generated audio.
